"evidence":"bakit may training pa sa dagat pwede naman sa swimming pool! at kung ang trip naman ay sa dagat ng management ng ateneo wala man kayong safety precaution para sa mga tao ni walang medic or safeguard? at least meron man lang naka jet ski or lifeguard na nag iikot-ikot to watching them na case na meron man hindi inaasahan insidente gaya niyan ay meron agad magre-response ma save sila case hindi kayanin ano po ateneo ! dapat managot kayo sa ginagawa ninyo !!",
"evidence_en":"Why is there still training at sea when it could be in a swimming pool! This is unacceptable, Ateneo! You should be held accountable for what you're doing!!",
